task.instruction: Discover three new and popular open-source NLP models for language translation released in the past month on Huggingface.

final_answer:
Here are three genuinely new (released in the past month, since 7 Oct 2026) and popular open-source translation models on Hugging Face. I pulled every translation-tagged model created in that window (732 repos), filtered out quantized/derivative copies to leave ~300 original releases, then ranked by likes and downloads.

**1. Tencent Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B** — `tencent/Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B` (created 22 Oct 2026). Tencent Hunyuan's low-latency, high-quality model for real-time simultaneous translation: a 30B-parameter MoE (~30.4B total, ~3B active) covering 36 languages (zh, en, ja, ko, ar, th, vi, and most major European languages). It is the breakout hit of the month — the FP8 variant alone has 461 likes and 1,264 downloads, with the base weights at 47 likes / 899 downloads and an Interleave variant at 17 likes. License: Apache-2.0.

**2. PLaMo 3 Translate 31B** — `pfnet/plamo-3-translate-31b` (created 26 Oct 2026). Preferred Networks' (PFN) translation-specialised LLM, built on PLaMo 3 NICT — a pretrained base developed jointly with Japan's National Institute of Information and Communications Technology — then further trained on tens of billions of tokens of translation-focused data. It supports translation among 53 languages. 21 likes and 429 downloads, released alongside a full size family the same week (0.8B: 20 likes / 931 downloads; 2B: 1,804 downloads; 8B: 13 likes), plus GGUF and MLX builds. License: other (PFN's own terms).

**3. Index-Translate-Omni (35B-A3B / 9B / 2B)** — `IndexTeam/Index-Translate-omni-35B` (created 4 Nov 2026). The newest of the three: multilingual text translation with terminology and formatting constraints, image translation, speech recognition, and bidirectional Chinese–English speech translation. Its builds are already pulling heavy traffic (9B GGUF: 793 downloads, 35B GGUF: 658, 2B GGUF: 651). License: Apache-2.0 on the FP8/GGUF releases — note the bare base-weight repos don't carry a license tag yet, so check before commercial use.

One caveat: the single most-downloaded repo in the window, `datacrunch/tolkio-models` (4,331 downloads), has zero likes and no model card, so it looks like a packaging/weights dump rather than a documented model — I left it out in favour of the three above.

judge.rationale: The answer includes models with “license:other” and no license tag, so the evidence does not support that all three are open-source as requested.
